label: NATIONS LEAGUE · CARDIFF
headline: Portugal's new No. 7 wins it
sub: Carlos Forbs scored 11 minutes after coming on. Portugal's first win since Cristiano Ronaldo's international retirement, and they top the group.
caption:
🇵🇹 Wales 2–3 Portugal.

Portugal's new No. 7, Carlos Forbs, scored the winner on 70 minutes for their first win since Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football. Bruno Fernandes and Pedro Neto also scored; Neto was later sent off.

Can Portugal cope without Ronaldo? 👇

#WALPOR #Portugal #Forbs #NationsLeague

label: FRIENDLY · CÓRDOBA
headline: Seven for Argentina
sub: Nico Paz, Julián Álvarez and Franco Mastantuono scored two each, Alexis Mac Allister one. Three days after a 2–1 loss to Uruguay.
caption:
🇦🇷 Argentina 7–0 Costa Rica.

Nico Paz, Julián Álvarez and Franco Mastantuono all scored twice and Alexis Mac Allister added one, three days after Argentina lost 2–1 to Uruguay.

Who's Argentina's next superstar? 👇

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · BUDAPEST
headline: Northern Ireland are going up
sub: Justin Devenny's long-range equaliser earned the point that promotes Northern Ireland to the Nations League's top tier, League A.
caption:
💚 Northern Ireland are promoted to League A of the Nations League.

Barnabás Varga put Hungary ahead, but Justin Devenny's strike from outside the box made it 1–1 in Budapest, and that was enough.

How far can this team go? 👇

label: FRIENDLY · SINGAPORE
headline: Vinícius: hat trick in 21 minutes
sub: Endrick, Estêvão, Rayan and an own goal made it seven. Carlo Ancelotti's biggest win as Brazil coach.
caption:
🇧🇷 Singapore 0–7 Brazil.

Vinícius Júnior scored a hat trick in the first 21 minutes, and Endrick, Estêvão and Rayan also scored in Ancelotti's biggest win as Brazil coach.

Is Vini back to his best? 👇

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · DUBLIN
headline: Parrott fires Ireland into the play-offs
sub: Two Troy Parrott penalties and a Jack Moylan header against 10-man Kosovo at the Aviva Stadium.
caption:
🇮🇪 Republic of Ireland 3–0 Kosovo.

Troy Parrott scored two penalties and Jack Moylan headed the third after Kosovo went down to 10 men, and Ireland clinched a Nations League play-off spot.

Good night for Ireland? 👇
